description: L Shaped loft conversion with rooflights on front slope, ground floor side extension to rear, reinstate 1st floor mural window at front, bike storage shed in front garden, BBQ and pizza oven in rear garden, ASHP on 1st floor side facing wall at rear

Condition : 3 - Materials as Specified - The facing materials to be used for the development hereby permitted shall be those specified in the application form unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority save for the materials for the mural window whihc must be agreed with the LPA.

Condition : 4 - Materials to be Approved - No relevant development shall take place until details of particulars and samples of the materials to be used for the new mural window hereby permitted on the front elevation (notwithstanding any materials specified in the application form and/or the approved drawings), have been submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval. No works which are the subject of this condition shall be carried out until the details are approved, and the development shall be carried out in full accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 5 - Obscured Glazing - Before the development hereby permitted is first occupied, the first floor window in the side elevation as shown in drawing A06REV1 shall be glazed with obscured glass and shall be maintained as such thereafter.

Condition : 6 - No Use of Flat Roof  - Access to the flat roof of the development hereby permitted shall be for maintenance or emergency purposes only, and the flat roof shall not be used as a roof garden, terrace, patio or similar amenity area.

Condition : 7 - INFORMATIVE
Note to Applicant -Approved Schemes
